Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: Initial misunderstanding by the Planner agent incorrectly identified the actress as Natalie Wood. Natalie Wood did not play the role of the little girl, Susan Walker, in the 1947 version of "Miracle on 34th Street." The role was actually played by Natalie Wood, who is often recognized for the role in the original film. The Webster confirms her role in the renowned film, though extra steps were taken to ensure accuracy, resulting in some confusion around her family relationship information.
